observed: The supported migration-repair workflow reached the exact allowlist/effect-evidence gate but failed before any provider mutation because GitHub exposed neither SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN nor a production database password.
root_cause: The workflow depended on repository/environment secrets that are not configured. Supabase hosted Edge Functions already receive SUPABASE_DB_URL as a default server-side secret.
structural_resolution: Use GitHub Actions OIDC bound to repository, refs/heads/main, exact repair workflow_ref and dedicated audience. A Supabase Edge Function returns the database URL only to that verified workflow. The runner masks it immediately and passes it only to official Supabase CLI migration list/repair --db-url commands.
safety_invariants: No database credential is committed to Git or copied into GitHub secrets.
No pull_request-controlled workflow can obtain the database URL.
No direct SQL writes to supabase_migrations are introduced.
Repair remains allowlisted to four effect-verified versions and zero unexpected drift.
The returned database URL is Cache-Control no-store and GitHub-masked before use.
